description.text: Generations Start Decks, released on 31 January 2025 in game shops and on 1 February 2025 in other stores: ready-built 60-card decks, each themed on a region from the Pokémon games and holding two Pokémon ex. Every deck has two Professor's Research in a professor's art of its own and a Black Belt's Training in its own art. This set holds the cards of all the decks.

tell.text: An "SVM" mark with an "I" beside it at the bottom left, and a number out of 175
